generations.topic: A city drive after a breakup
generations.lyrics:
Gridline Ghosts

(Verse 1)
Engine hums a low confession,
Past the glow of fractured signs.
Every street, a new progression,
Leaving old timelines behind.
Your phantom hand, a chill beside me,
On the polished, vacant seat.
Only city pulse to guide me,
Through the rhythm of defeat.

(Pre-Chorus)
The rearview mirror blurs the past,
A silent promise, shattered vow.
This dizzying speed, it won't outlast
The aching question of "how now?"
My vision blurs, the streetlights gleam,
A future flickering like a dream.

(Chorus)
Underneath the neon arches,
My chrome heart beats an empty sound.
Miles unwind through lonely marches,
As your memory spins around.
No destination, just the glow,
Of a city that never sleeps.
Watching shadows come and go,
A secret that the asphalt keeps.

(Verse 2)
Familiar corner, once our haven,
Now a hollow, spectral space.
Each memory etched, a sharp engraven,
On the city's stoic face.
The distant hum, a fading echo,
Of laughter shared beneath the stars.
Just the streetlights, cold and shallow,
Reflecting all my open scars.

(Chorus)
Underneath the neon arches,
My chrome heart beats an empty sound.
Miles unwind through lonely marches,
As your memory spins around.
No destination, just the glow,
Of a city that never sleeps.
Watching shadows come and go,
A secret that the asphalt keeps.

(Bridge)
I accelerate, the world dissolves to streaks of light,
Trying to outrun the silence of this endless night.
Maybe there’s a dawn beyond this digital despair,
A frequency unseen, a whisper in the air.
This engine's pulse, a fragile, hopeful plea,
To find the rhythm that belongs to only me.

(Chorus)
Underneath the neon arches,
My chrome heart beats an empty sound.
Miles unwind through lonely marches,
As your memory spins around.
No destination, just the glow,
Of a city that never sleeps.
Watching shadows come and go,
A secret that the asphalt keeps.
